title: Proofs of Prophethood 23: Challenge to Priests
normalized_text: during the tenth year after the hijra the prophet peace be upon him was visited by some priests from nejiran and hassan al-basri reports that when this occurred there was a discussion a debate over the subject of the identity of the father of jesus peace be upon him the prophet peace be upon him rebuked them for their views and they simply asked him well then who is the father of jesus al hasan bastari states that he waited until he received the following revelation indeed the example of jesus to allah is like that of adam he created him from dust then he said to him be and he was by that of course the verse is affirming that jesus like adam didn't have a father the quran then includes this order directed at the prophet peace be upon him then whoever argues with you about it after this knowledge has come to you say come let us call our sons and your sons our women and your women ourselves and yourselves then supplicate earnestly together and invoke the curse of allah upon the liars among us upon this the prophet came forward with his son-in-law and cousin ali his daughter fatima and his grandsons el al-hassan and hussain the priests from najib did not see this through instead they withdrew from the challenge to curse one another but how is this proof of prophethood argues that firstly this shows the confidence of the prophet peace be upon him in that if they actually accepted this challenge they would have definitely been cursed the prophet peace be upon him was a believing man and his sincerity was shown through his actions for more evidence of that please check out my video on the proofs of prophethood through the narrations of aisha now if he was a believing man then he had his doubts about his claims that he wouldn't have brought his family along with him and risked having them getting cursed now keep in mind that this is a curse that's supposed to occur immediately it's not one of those things it's like whoever dies first is cursed or anything like that he brought his family there to show that they would be cursed on the spot this was something that was supposed to occur at that specific moment ibn abbas mentions that if the priests actually accepted this challenge they would have returned home to nejiran finding their families dead and their wealth gone and due to this the priests returned and refused to accept this challenge now let's assume that the supernatural simply never occurred what then well if that was the case then this would have looked bad upon the prophet peace be upon him because nothing would happen you'd expect something to occur to those or the family of those that accept this challenge and yet nothing occurring would simply cause people to doubt in the prophet peace be upon him and his claim of prophethood so the question is once again why would you even put yourself in that situation why would you risk that unless you were certain that they would actually be cursed and that my friends is why this is a proof of prophethood see you guys in the next one assalamu alaikum to light wabarakatuh
